harvestMonths.region: Little Karoo and drier Cape botanical account — edible seed production reference

evidence.quote: Seeds are produced in May and June of each year.

harvestMonths.notes: Source states that both green and mature seeds are edible. This is a botanical seed-production reference, not a guaranteed household picking schedule.

supplementaryReferences.title: Edible part and local use
supplementaryReferences.quote: The seeds are edible either green or mature.
supplementaryReferences.note: Edibility is recorded for this exact variety; do not apply the common name boer-bean to every species as food evidence.

care: Its natural setting includes dry stream banks in the Little Karoo and drier Eastern and southern Western Cape.
The pods disperse seeds when dry. Record your local seed collection and use; this is not a measured food yield.
purchase: Ask for Schotia afra var. afra, with botanical identity confirmed. The source's five-year shade claim is not a first-food age.
